req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts a partial payload and leaves omitted fields unchanged. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — sending only one field updates that field and preserves others; (2) negative NEG — sending an invalid/non-existent task_id returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — title at exactly 1 character (min_length boundary) and at 100 characters (max_length boundary); (4) DT — updating each individual field independently to confirm field-level isolation; (5) STC — transitioning completed from false→true and true→false via partial payload. All tests use pre-loaded rows (ids 1-20) and in-process TestClient. Assertions are exact-value to kill constant, operator, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_title_preserves_other_fields
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with payload {"title": "Fixed login bug"} (omitting description and completed)
expected: Response description == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.' (unchanged)
trace: R-TASK-012: partial payload accepted; omitted fields unchanged
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine, SessionLocal
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
task = models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,41,54))
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.put('/tasks/7', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug'})
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['id'] == 7
assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
assert body['description'] == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
assert body['completed'] == False

def test_partial_update_only_title_preserves_other_fields():
